observations.title: Dkny Black Monogram Canvas and Leather Envelope Flap Shoulder Bag
observations.description: Designer bags are ideal companions for ample occasions Here we have a fashion meets functionality piece crafted with precision. It has been equipped with a well sized interior that can easily fit your small essentials.

observations.title: Michael Kors Rhea Beige Leather Backpacks
observations.description: Get set to look uber stylish with this beige backpack from Michael Kors. It has been crafted from leather it flaunts zippers that reveal a spacious fabric lined interior, a zip pocket on the front and shoulder straps. This piece is very much in vogue, so get your hands on this today
